vulnerabilities.description: See CVE-2026-45447 entry on libssl3. Mirrored here because Trivy reports the Ubuntu Noble package under the libssl3t64 name.
vulnerabilities.recommendation: No action required. Liquibase Secure does not process PKCS#7 or S/MIME signed messages through OpenSSL PKCS#7 APIs.

ratings.justification: Liquibase Secure does not invoke OpenSSL PKCS#7/S/MIME verification APIs, so the vulnerable code path is not reachable from the application.

analysis.detail: Scanner over-match: libssl3t64 is Ubuntu Noble's time64 ABI transition rename of libssl3 (see sibling assessment above). The same not_affected rationale applies — Liquibase Secure does not process PKCS#7 or S/MIME signed messages through OpenSSL PKCS#7 APIs, and no PKCS7_verify, PKCS7_, S/MIME, or related call sites exist in repository sources.
